propositions: Implement nested `rebar bridge` CLI group exposing only functional `preview` (read-only, dry-run mode) and `sync` (mutating, live mode) verbs with pinned exit/stream contracts.
Reject `--mode`, `--filter-local-ids`, and arbitrary trailing arguments on both verbs to prevent read/write distinction override.
Ensure unknown nested verbs fail with valid choices and never dispatch a same-named top-level command.
Preview must perform zero Jira writes and zero ticket or bridge-state writes; sync must perform persisted mutations while preserving unrelated state.
Keep legacy top-level `reconcile`, `jira-onboard`, `bridge-probe`, `bridge-fsck`, and `doctor` commands unchanged and routable through existing dispatch paths.
Update CLI reference generation, exit-codes documentation, user guide, and release notes to describe only the staged bridge surface shipped in this story.
